item.g:title: Le Mans Rooftop Ventilator 12V · White
item.g:description: The Le Mans is where style meets raw airflow. A sleek, low-profile cover (only 64 mm above the roof, so it sits happily next to solar panels) hides a motor that moves 850 m³/h in either direction: suck hot, humid or contaminated air out, or blow fresh air in. It is the ventilator that bodybuilders across Europe specify when a vehicle simply has to stay fresh. Choose 12V for vans, campers and passenger vehicles, or 24V for trucks, coaches and buses. Both versions are EMC approved, so they are tested not to interfere with your vehicle electronics. Prefer a passive solution? The motorless version uses the same 230 mm roof cut-out and can be upgraded to electric later. Finish the installation with a 3-way switch (blow / off / suck), an optional speed controller and one of our interior valves or grilles. Everything fits the same 230 mm opening.

item.g:title: Le Mans LL Brushless Rooftop Ventilator 12V
item.g:description: The Le Mans LL takes the proven Le Mans shape and fits it with a brushless motor. The result: a ventilator that runs for years without servicing, draws only 34 W and is available with an integrated speed control unit. The LL is an extraction-only ventilator, which is exactly what most loading areas, animal compartments and coach toilets need: a constant, healthy discharge of humid or contaminated air. Pair it with a floor ventilator for a complete airflow loop. Order the 12V or 24V version, with or without built-in speed control. An interior valve is available separately. Saw template included.

item.g:title: Round Rooftop Ventilator 12V · White
item.g:description: Our round electric rooftop ventilator delivers a healthy supply and exhaust of air in commercial vehicles, campers and cars. It shares the Le Mans motor platform (850 m³/h, 80 W) but uses a round Ø 320 mm cover, just 62 mm high, that suits many classic vehicle roofs and fits under most roof racks. Use the 3-position switch to choose intake or extraction, and add the speed controller to dial the airflow (and the noise) down when you only need a trickle of fresh air overnight. Available in 12V and 24V, white or black, and as a motorless version that can be motorised later. The cover can be painted in your body colour.

item.g:title: Winglet Mini Roof Fan 12V · White
item.g:description: The Winglet is our answer for spaces where a full-size roof fan is overkill: a VW Caddy, the kitchen of a motorhome, a caravan washroom or an equipment locker. It pulls 65 m³/h of stale air out at only 3 W, so it can run all night on a leisure battery. Installation is a single 80 mm hole. The unit comes complete with interior grille, an open/close valve and a saw template, and the low-profile cover (230 x 196 mm, 52 mm high) sits well below most roof racks. Available in white or black, electric (12V) or motorless.

item.g:title: Turbo II Wind-Driven Rooftop Ventilator Black
item.g:description: The Turbo II is the classic mushroom-style rotating vent, refined. Airflow over the roof spins the UV-stabilised ABS cowl on two ball bearings and a venturi effect pulls air out of the vehicle: roughly 245 m³/h at 100 km/h. No wiring, no power draw, no noise. It simply works whenever the vehicle moves or the wind blows. At 68 mm high it fits under most roof racks. The 128 mm bore hole and 26 mm installation depth make it an easy retrofit, and the kit includes an interior grille and closable shutter so you can shut it off in winter. Perfect for transporting dogs, horses and cargo that must not sit in stale air. Combine it with a floor ventilator for a continuous flow even when parked.

item.g:title: Turbo III Compact Wind-Driven Ventilator White
item.g:description: The Turbo III is a smaller wind-driven ventilator for spaces where every millimetre counts. It needs just an 80 mm hole, stands 59.5 mm tall and slides under almost any roof rack. Like its bigger brother it spins on two ball bearings and extracts air by venturi effect (roughly 120 m³/h at 100 km/h), but it assembles in minutes and requires no glue. The inside is finished with a stylish grille and an open/close valve. Ideal for venting boats, dog transporters, small service vans, caravans and coaches. Made in Holland.

item.g:title: Exhaust Ventilator (Venturi) White
item.g:description: The mechanical exhaust ventilator is the simplest way to keep a commercial vehicle fresh: wind passing over the cover pulls air from the cargo area below. No power, no maintenance, no noise, and it keeps working with a light breeze even when parked. Thanks to its 50 mm height it works under roof racks, and because it needs no wiring the installation is quick: cut a hole of up to 140 mm, bond with body sealant (never silicone) and fit the interior grille. Combine it with our floor ventilator for a steady supply of fresh air, or pair it with an electric roof fan for forced ventilation when parked. Available in white or black. Finish the inside with the Ø 140 mm ABS grille.

item.g:title: V12 Interior Ventilation Valve Manual · White
item.g:description: The V12 is the interior valve most customers pair with the Le Mans. It covers the 230 mm roof opening with a clean Ø 290 mm louvre (only 20 mm high) that you can open and close by hand, or electrically from your dashboard with the 12/24V version. It also acts as a finger guard for the fan blades. Made from high-quality ABS, it is a statement piece rather than just a functional cover. Three colour combinations let it blend into any interior: white, grey or dark grey. Designed for vehicles with a headliner or ceiling. Tip: order the electric version together with a Le Mans, a 3-way switch for the fan and a separate on/off switch for the valve, and you have a fully remote-controlled ventilation system.

item.g:description: Flower Power is our design interior valve: a Ø 280 mm closable grille with a distinctive radial pattern that looks as good in a luxury horsebox as in a camper. It keeps the full airflow of your roof ventilator while letting you shut it off completely. Choose the plain version in white, light grey or light grey with dark grey accent, or the LED version with 21 white and 9 blue LEDs for courtesy and night lighting, in 12V or 24V. Designed for vehicles with a canopy or ceiling. No ceiling? Choose a standard grille instead.

item.g:title: Speedcontrol 30-3004
item.g:description: The Speedcontrol lets you run any of our DC roof fans at exactly the speed you need: from a silent trickle to full power. The range is stepless from 0 to 100%, and at the zero position the unit draws no current at all. Rated for 11 to 30 VDC and 25 A continuous (30 A peak), it works on 12V and 24V systems and can control one or several ventilators at once. The housing is waterproof, the unit is current-limited and transient-suppressed, and it connects with standard 6.3 mm flat connectors. Supplied with potentiometer knob and instructions.

item.g:title: 3-Way Switch Round 89-4002 Round
item.g:description: The round 3-position switch for our rooftop ventilators. Flick up for intake, down for exhaust, centre for off. It is a double-changeover switch that reverses the motor, so you get both directions from a single control. Suitable for most vehicles: it presses into a round dashboard hole or a prepared switch holder. Check the mounting hole dimensions in the datasheet before ordering. Combine with the Speedcontrol for stepless speed adjustment.

item.g:title: 3-Way Switch Square 89-4005 Square
item.g:description: The square 3-position switch for our rooftop ventilators. Up for intake, down for exhaust, centre off. Double changeover, so one switch reverses the motor. A square built-in model for most vehicles; it presses into a prepared holder or rectangular cut-out (dimensions in the datasheet). Add the Speedcontrol to make the fan run steplessly from 0 to 100%.

item.g:title: Fan Switch 89-4008 with Symbols
item.g:description: The Fan Switch is the one to choose when the dashboard has to look OEM. A rectangular rocker with a printed ventilation symbol, red and amber illumination, and three positions: intake, off, exhaust. It is a double-changeover switch that reverses the motor, suitable for 12V (25 A) and 24V (15 A) systems. It presses into a standard rectangular holder; check the cut-out dimensions in the datasheet. Combine with the Speedcontrol for stepless airflow.

item.g:title: Roof Hatch Control Unit 30-6000 Control Unit 24V
item.g:description: Always use the 30-6000 with our electric roof hatches. This compact 24V control unit manages one or two hatches: open or close the front and rear side independently, and read the dome position on the green LED display. Safety and comfort are built in. The unit closes the hatches automatically when the ignition key is turned off, but the hatch can still be opened for ventilation while parked. The display has a current-save function and the push buttons are illuminated with orange LEDs for operation in the dark. EMC approved and homologated according to EC 2004/104. For 12V vehicles a 12V to 24V converter is available on request.

item.g:title: Floor Ventilator Ø 129 mm Ø 129 mm
item.g:description: A roof fan can only extract what it can replace. The floor ventilator gives your vehicle a low air inlet so the roof fan works at full capacity and a constant flow runs from floor to roof. At the same time it removes heavy, low-hanging gases. Mount it diagonally opposite the roof ventilator for the best cross-flow. Made from tough PC/ABS with a Ø 129 mm cut-out (Ø 169 mm flange, 90 mm deep), it is the standard recommendation with every mechanical or electric rooftop ventilator. Particularly suitable when transporting gas bottles, dogs, animals and oil-containing products, and for meeting the ventilation guidance for gas cylinders in closed vans.

item.g:title: Floor Ventilator Ø 80 mm Ø 80 mm
item.g:description: The 80 mm floor ventilator brings the same logic to small vehicles: create a low inlet so your Winglet, Turbo III or exhaust ventilator can actually move air, and let heavy gases escape at floor level. PC/ABS, black RAL 9005, Ø 80 mm cut-out, Ø 119 mm outer, 90 mm deep, 0.4 kg. Recommended with any mechanical or electric rooftop ventilator.

item.g:title: Snow Filter 89-5011 860 x 40 x 10 mm
item.g:description: Our roof ventilators are built so that virtually no rainwater enters the vehicle, but in snow, heavy weather or insect season a filter is the final safeguard. The snow filter is a medium, coarse-mesh net of carbon-infused polymer that shields the intake while leaving the airflow almost untouched. The 89-5011 fits the 02-0200/0300 Round and 02-2200/2300 Le Mans ventilators. Recommended for vehicles operating in regions where snow can be drawn into the air intake.

item.g:title: Roof Hatch Manual 530 x 530 Manual 530 x 530
item.g:description: Our small roof hatch brings daylight, ventilation and privacy to minibuses, horse trucks, ambulances and campers. The dark tinted glass dome is homologated ECE 43R (UV transmission 6%, heat 16%, light 17%), and the hatch is homologated according to EC 2004/104. The internal frame mounts easily inside the outside frame, which comes pre-drilled with mounting holes (outer frame 640 x 640 mm, 40 mm high; screw or bond). High-quality gaskets keep wind and water out. Suits roof thicknesses from 30 to 70 mm. Need automation? The same hatch is available as an electric version (90-5000-E).

item.g:title: Roof Hatch Manual 970 x 530 Emergency Exit Manual 970 x 530
item.g:description: The large emergency roof hatch for buses, coaches and specialty vehicles. At 970 x 530 mm it meets the EC 2001/85 emergency exit standard and doubles as a generous ventilation and daylight opening. The dark tinted glass dome is homologated ECE 43R and the hatch is homologated EC 2004/104. High-quality gaskets, an internal frame that mounts easily in the pre-drilled outside frame (1080 x 640 mm), interior trim frame and a break-glass hammer complete the package. Suits roof thicknesses from 30 to 70 mm. Also available as an electric version (90-6000-E) with our 30-6000 control unit.

item.g:title: Roof Hatch Electric 530 x 530 Electric 530 x 530
item.g:description: Elevate the experience with push-button operation. The electric small roof hatch opens front or rear at the touch of the 30-6000 control unit, shows its position on the display and closes automatically when you switch off the ignition. Dark tinted ECE 43R glass dome, EMC approved, homologated EC 2004/104, high-quality gaskets and a pre-drilled outer frame (640 x 640 mm). Suits roof thicknesses from 30 to 70 mm. 24V as standard. For 12V vehicles a 12V to 24V converter is available on request. Always combine with the 30-6000 control unit.

item.g:title: Roof Hatch Electric 970 x 530 Emergency Exit Electric 970 x 530
item.g:description: Our flagship roof hatch redefines safety and comfort for buses, coaches and emergency vehicles. It combines an EC 2001/85 compliant emergency exit with electric operation: open front or rear from the 30-6000 control unit, read the position on the display, and let it close automatically when the ignition goes off. The standard dark tinted glass dome is homologated ECE 43R and reduces glare and heat. The hatch is EMC approved and homologated EC 2004/104, fits roof thicknesses from 30 to 70 mm, and comes with high-quality gaskets, a pre-drilled outer frame (1080 x 640 mm) and a break-glass hammer. 24V as standard; for 12V vehicles a converter is available on request. Always combine with the 30-6000 control unit.

item.g:title: Dome LED Light Round Ø 150 mm White
item.g:description: The round Dome LED Light is the interior light fitted in horse trucks, ambulances and commercial vehicles that need reliable, glare-free lighting. 24 white LEDs give 230 lm of bright working light at only 2 W, 6 blue LEDs provide a soft night mode that does not disturb animals or patients. Dual voltage 12V/24V, IP67 sealed against dust and water, IK10 impact resistant, and dimmable to 50% through the wiring (black ground, red 100%, white 50%, blue night light). Only 13.5 mm thick and 150 g. Rated for 40,000 hours, -40 to +85 °C. Available in white or grey, and made in the Netherlands.

item.g:title: Dome LED Light Rectangle 350 x 140 mm Grey
item.g:description: The rectangular Dome LED Light is the workhorse for buses, ambulances, horse trucks and service vehicles: 39 white LEDs (around 5000 K, approx. 368 lm) for bright, even light and 12 blue LEDs for a calm night mode. Built to last: IP66 sealed (IP67 optional), vandal resistant to IK10, dual voltage 12V/24V DC with a 230V AC option. Dim to 50% through the wiring (black ground, red 100%, white 50%, blue night light). 350 x 140 mm, only 13.6 mm thick. Made in the Netherlands, chromium finish optional.

item.g:title: Dome LED Light Rectangle 350 x 140 mm White
item.g:description: The rectangular Dome LED Light is the workhorse for buses, ambulances, horse trucks and service vehicles: 39 white LEDs (around 5000 K, approx. 368 lm) for bright, even light and 12 blue LEDs for a calm night mode. item.g:title: Ceilingflow Ceiling Fan Black
item.g:description: Ceilingflow is the plug-and-play ceiling fan for offices, workshops, showrooms, shops, schools, kitchens, meeting rooms and server rooms. Remove a ceiling tile, insert the Ceilingflow (595 x 595 x 166 mm, 5.5 kg), plug it in and play. No installation costs, no installer, under five minutes. With 130 m³/min of airflow at only 27 to 41 W and a noise level of 35 to 47 dB(A), it cools on warm days and pushes warm air back down on cold days, making optimal use of the vertical temperature profile of your heating. Three speeds, reversible direction and timer on the RF remote. Brushless motor with short-circuit and peak-voltage protection, recyclable ABS, RoHS, CE and LVD certified, IP44. Remote control included (can also be operated without). Frame for solid ceilings available separately. One unit covers roughly 40 to 50 m².

item.g:title: Ceilingflow Frame for Solid Ceilings White
item.g:description: The Ceilingflow is designed to drop into a 600 x 600 suspended-ceiling tile. No suspended ceiling? This frame mounts to any solid ceiling and holds the fan at the correct distance for airflow. Choose white (24-0013) or black (24-0113) to match your Ceilingflow.

item.g:title: Ceilingflow Frame for Solid Ceilings Black
item.g:description: The Ceilingflow is designed to drop into a 600 x 600 suspended-ceiling tile. No suspended ceiling? This frame mounts to any solid ceiling and holds the fan at the correct distance for airflow. Choose white (24-0013) or black (24-0113) to match your Ceilingflow.

item.g:title: HEPA Air Purifier Small (8 to 15 m²) Small
item.g:description: The 24-0125 is perfect for individual workstations, bedrooms and other areas with limited floor space. The 360° bottom air inlet and top outlet pull polluted air through an H13 HEPA and activated carbon filter and return clean air to the room. CADR 125 m³/h (PM), TVOC CADR 40 to 60 m³/h, three speeds from a whisper-quiet 27 dB. 25 W, child lock, 1.8 kg, sleek matt dark grey.

item.g:title: HEPA Air Purifier Large (42 to 74 m²) Large
item.g:description: The 24-0600 is ideal for large spaces where high-capacity filtration is required: meeting rooms, lobbies, open-plan offices, classrooms. H13 HEPA, activated carbon and an anion purifier (10 million/cm³) tackle fine dust, bacteria, viruses, dust mites, mould, pollen and odours. PM CADR 600 m³/h, TVOC CADR 200 to 390 m³/h, six speeds from a 32.9 dB sleep mode, filter replacement reminder, child lock and a remote control that works from up to 5 metres. Matt grey, universal wheels, 10.5 kg.

item.g:title: On/Off Rocker Switch for the Winglet On/off rocker switch
item.g:description: The Winglet draws only a few watts, so it does not need a 3-way switch or a speed controller. This compact rocker switch is the matching on/off control: snap it into a panel cut-out, connect the two spade terminals and the fan is ready. The switch is the only switch that fits the Winglet system; the 3-way switches in our range are made for the Le Mans and Round ventilators.

item.g:title: Super Seal Roof Filler Foam Super Seal foam strip
item.g:description: Bus and coach roofs are rarely flat: corrugations, roof ribs and panel joints leave gaps under the base of a rooftop ventilator. The Super Seal foam strip follows every contour, compresses when the fan is tightened down and closes the gap completely, so rain, dust and draughts stay outside. Cut the strip to length, lay it in the base of the Le Mans or Round ventilator before mounting and tighten the fan as usual. The foam recovers its shape, so the seal stays tight when the body flexes on the road.

item.g:title: LED Rock Light LED rock light, single
item.g:description: The rock light is the compact answer to dark corners: a sealed housing the size of a matchbox, two mounting eyes and a fixed cable. Nine SMD LEDs behind a clear lens give a bright, even spread of light, and the low profile means it can be bolted almost anywhere. Use it inside a van or trailer for cargo areas, tool lockers and steps, or outside on the underside and wheel arches. Wire it to a switch or to the courtesy-light circuit and it simply works.

item.g:title: Stainless Steel Floor Ventilator Ø 129 mm
item.g:description: A roof fan needs an inlet. On floors that see hooves, forklifts and a pressure washer, that inlet should be stainless: the top plate takes the load, the louvred body keeps splashes and road spray out while the air comes in. Choose Ø 83 mm for smaller bodies and Ø 129 mm for the same airflow as our PC/ABS floor ventilator. Both drop into a round floor cut-out and are fixed with three screws through the top plate.

item.g:title: Stainless Steel Floor Ventilator Ø 83 mm
item.g:description: A roof fan needs an inlet. item.g:title: LED Reading Light with Switch LED reading light, white
item.g:description: A focused LED spot you switch on and off at the light itself. The lens head rotates so the beam lands where you want it, and the switch sits in the housing, so there is no separate switch to wire into the panel. Screw the base to any flat surface and connect the two wires; the light draws only a few watts, which makes it ideal for bunks in horse trucks and campers, workbenches in service vans and reading in a cab.
